standard_prerequisites.name: Mayer-Vietoris for morphisms in the derived category and the induction principle for quasi-compact opens
standard_prerequisites.use: Glues the vanishing bound and reduces to the affine case, at the cost of increasing the bound by one at each gluing.

standard_prerequisites.name: On an affine scheme the derived category of quasi-coherent modules is equivalent to the derived category of modules, and for a complex with projective terms morphisms in the derived category are computed on the level of cohomology
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the Ext group into Hom_A(P, H^n(M^bullet)).

standard_prerequisites.name: Hom out of a projective module is an exact functor
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies the final equality with Hom into the cohomology module.

core_obligations: Glue: by Mayer-Vietoris for Hom, if the vanishing holds on U, V and U cap V with bound n_0, it holds on X = U cup V with bound n_0 + 1; the induction principle reduces to the affine case (proof lines 3428-3434).

Affine setup: represent E by a bounded complex of A-modules M^bullet via the affine comparison, and write the finite locally free E-tilde as the sheaf associated to a finite projective A-module P (proof lines 3437-3442).

Compute: Hom(E, E[n]) = Hom_{D(A)}(P, M^bullet[n]) = Hom_{K(A)}(P, M^bullet[n]) = Hom_A(P, H^n(M^bullet)), the equalities by the affine comparison, the projective-morphism lemma, and exactness of Hom_A(P, -); since M^bullet is bounded, H^n = 0 for all sufficiently large n and the vanishing holds (proof lines 3443-3455).
proof_roadmap: Glue the bound over opens and reduce to the affine case (proof lines 3428-3434).
Represent E and the finite locally free module by modules over the affine ring (proof lines 3437-3442).
Compute the Hom group on cohomology and conclude by boundedness (proof lines 3443-3455).
difficulty_reason: 35 行、两段式：①Mayer-Vietoris for Hom 把消失界沿开集粘合（每次粘合损失 +1），induction principle 归到仿射；②仿射上 affine-compare 把 E 写成有界模复形 M^bullet，有限局部自由层写成有限投射模 P 的伴随；③三连等式 Hom(E,E[n]) = Hom_{D(A)}(P, M[n]) = Hom_{K(A)}(P, M[n]) = Hom_A(P, H^n(M))——分别是 affine-compare、投射复形态射引理、Hom_A(P,-) 正合；④M^bullet 有界 ⇒ n 充分大时 H^n=0 ⇒ Ext 消失。承重全在 span 内；4 处引用（2 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。
